query:
Extract the image field from this kubernetes deployment yaml on the command line: ```yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: api
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: api
        image: myrepo/api:v1.2.3
```

Edit replicas in place in this manifest without trashing the comments: ```yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: web  # production deployment
spec:
  replicas: 2  # change to 5
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: web
```

Merge these two yaml configs while preserving comments and key order: ```yaml
# base.yaml
app:
  name: myservice  # service name
  port: 8080
  debug: false
# override.yaml
app:
  port: 9090
  debug: true
```

Convert this yaml file to json from the shell: ```yaml
name: app
version: 2.1.0
env:
  - name: DATABASE_URL
    value: postgres://localhost/mydb
  - name: REDIS_URL
    value: redis://localhost:6379
```

I have this multi-document kubernetes manifest — pull just the Deployment out: ```yaml
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: api
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: api
spec:
  replicas: 3
```

Round-trip this TOML file to YAML and back: ```toml
[server]
host = "localhost"
port = 8080

[database]
url = "postgres://localhost/mydb"
pool_size = 10
```

Split this helm template output into one file per kind: ```yaml
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: app-config
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: app
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: app
```

Bump the image tag in this values.yaml to v1.2.3: ```yaml
replicaCount: 2
image:
  repository: myrepo/api
  tag: v1.1.0
  pullPolicy: IfNotPresent
service:
  type: ClusterIP
  port: 80
```

Read the `services.db.environment.DATABASE_URL` field out of this docker-compose file in bash: ```yaml
version: '3.8'
services:
  web:
    image: myapp:latest
    ports: ['8080:8080']
  db:
    image: postgres:15
    environment:
      DATABASE_URL: postgres://user:pass@db/mydb
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: pass
```

Delete the `metadata.annotations` block from this kubernetes resource on disk: ```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: app-config
  annotations:
    kubectl.kubernetes.io/last-applied-configuration: '{...}'
data:
  key: value
```

Override the `app.replicas` value in base.yaml with override.yaml at the CLI: ```yaml
# base.yaml
app:
  name: myservice
  replicas: 1
# override.yaml
app:
  replicas: 5
```
